allocation.rationale: C-FRESHNESS is Graph's dominant recent claim (5 of last 10) and the last TWO graph freshness certificates were MEASUREMENT_INVALID for control-plane DESIGN defects, not scientific negatives. The parent packet's failure is diagnosed as a conjoined unsatisfiable predicate (session_identifying_disjoint AND pairwise_disjoint_on_name_value_after_filter); the repaired disjunction fix is specific, cheap and untested. Graph's other priority claims are not yet actionable: C-DELTA-REPAIR is downstream of freshness detection plus a validated substrate and an executable inheritance path (both mid-flight in Runtime/Product); C-PARAM-INHERIT and C-LLM-INHERIT are owned by active Product/Intel work; C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE is blocked on its own unsatisfiable V9_CODE_HASHED_INTO_FREEZE control-plane defect. One more bounded certificate attempt, hardened with a pre-freeze satisfiability dry-run, is the cheapest decision-changing step and unblocks the C-FRESHNESS registry next_gate (session/token/DOM/endpoint/permission drift with false-accept measurement).

director_mandate.portfolio_assessment: The program holds no end-to-end validated causal chain, but four of six lanes are mid-flight on the right questions and must be allowed to finish. Runtime (frozen) is closing the last substrate scope bound -- whether its composite oracle discriminates changes induced OUTSIDE the surface its author wrote, and whether its byte-equality WAL blind spot is measured -- which gates every downstream real-drift claim. Product (executed) is on the audit's critical path: the shipped kernel's real parameterized round trip on a NON-synthetic credential-free substrate with causal attribution. Intel (frozen) is resolving whether the C-LLM-INHERIT four-arm benchmark is runnable at all without a human credential. Frontier (frozen) is measuring the hop-depth cost-scaling law that is the missing real cost curve under residual-novelty and freshness economics. Physics (pre-freeze) is a genuine pivot to a new observable (server-minted value predictability) that directly answers its tunnel flag. The single genuinely idle lane is Graph: its last two freshness certificates were MEASUREMENT_INVALID for control-plane DESIGN defects, not scientific negatives, and the diagnosed disjunction fix has not yet been tried. The highest-value Director actions this cycle are therefore to keep the four in-flight transactions intact, resume Physics's designed pre-freeze, and give Graph exactly one more bounded certificate attempt hardened with a pre-freeze satisfiability precondition; C-DELTA-REPAIR, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE and the four-arm benchmark remain blocked on prerequisites that the in-flight work is still establishing.
director_mandate.scout_assessment: The Scout ran in DEGRADED mode (model unavailable rc=124; agent_priors empty) and supplied no external evidence; its brief only echoed parent handoffs plus generic reassess prompts, so I treated it as staff advice only and used no Scout claim as evidence. It correctly flagged Graph (IDLE) and Physics (PREFREEZE) as requiring an explicit Director decision, which matched my independent read, so I decided both directly. I adopted the SUBSTANCE of its Graph candidate (the repaired disjunction GATE-C3 certificate) but hardened it with a pre-freeze satisfiability dry-run the brief did not require. I CHALLENGED and superseded its Physics candidate: the brief forwarded the lane's STALE parent handoff (query-parameter perturbation, already twice an empty-accept-region) whereas the active pre-freeze is a materially new observable (server-minted value predictability) installed by a prior Director pivot; continuing the active question is the better direction. Its question set correctly names the systemic issue (lanes repeating measurement-repair work) and I encoded a hard-stop rule for that pattern in the Graph reasoning.
